summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing daily open-market repurchases under its 5 August 2026 buy-back programme. On 10 September 2026 it bought 530,000 ordinary shares of US$0.50 on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of 15.2632 (high 15.5220, low 15.1600) and 300,000 shares in Hong Kong at a VWAP of HK$164.4059 (range HK$163.6000-165.1000), all for cancellation via BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC as broker. Cumulative repurchases since programme start total 28,085,814 shares for approximately US$579.6m, leaving issued ordinary share capital and total voting rights of 17,159,502,183 with no treasury shares. UK purchases are on-exchange market purchases; Hong Kong purchases are technically off-market but on-exchange under HK listing rules. Watch execution pace versus the announced authorisation, the residual buy-back capacity, any suspension ahead of results, and HK cancellation timing that could temporarily affect the voting-rights denominator used for disclosure calculations.
